title: PRESERVE & CONNECT: Impact Study of the BPC
official: Randomized Control Trial of the Breakthrough Parenting Curriculum: Transforming Trauma Across Generations
summary: The PRESERVE \& CONNECT project is a multi-site randomized control trial of the Breakthrough Parenting Curriculum: Navigating Trauma Across Generations (BPC) in rural and racially and ethnically diverse communities in Vermont and Connecticut.

interventions.name: Breakthrough Parenting Curriculum: Transforming trauma across generations

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Parents involved in, or at risk of involvement in, the child welfare system.

Exclusion Criteria:

* active psychosis without medication stabilization
* ongoing major depressive episodes
* active suicidal ideation
* active homicidal ideation
